dung01_puzzle04.name: Industrial Labyrinth
dung01_puzzle04.desc:
An extremely unstable Protocol Space. Expect the unexpected. 
"I believe this rift is a manifestation of some Endfielder's dreams. Perhaps it was Director Qin herself. She wanted something way bigger for her little Hub Base."
dung01_puzzle04.featureDesc: Find the correct path and reach the exit.
